#| label: tbl-literature_wp2
#| echo: false
#| cache: false
#| tbl-cap: "Overview of the literature summary."

read_csv(project_path("writings/pom/tables/lr_tbl.csv")) |>
  rename_with(~ gsub("Censorship", "Censoring", .x, fixed = TRUE)) |>
  knitr::kable(booktabs = T, linesep = "") |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "repeat_header"), font_size = 6) |>
  # kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "repeat_header"), font_size = 6) |> # for pom
  column_spec(1, "8em") |>
  column_spec(2, "12em") |>
  column_spec(3, "12em") |> 
  column_spec(4, "12em") |>
  column_spec(5, "12em") |>
  column_spec(6, "8em")
